svg.text: The project colour already tints the icons in the header and the nav row. Nothing else changes.
The header band takes a 14% wash of the project colour. Text stays neutral ink.
A 4px rail on the active nav row and a 3px rule under the header in the project colour.
A 6% wash behind the whole task area, on top of the icons. The boldest option.
Context identity: four variants for a paper test (project "Work", colour #3F7CAC)
